candidate_as_built.explanation: The grey-green paint is consistent across all views, with clean geometry and correct material roles for the bare hardware and fabric pad.

candidate_aged.explanation: The aged state shows convincing broad paint retention with irregular edge corrosion and downward rust runs, though the fabric pad could show slightly more wear.

locker_as_built.explanation: The reference locker presents a clean, uniform grey-green finish with sharp edges and clear hardware definition.

locker_aged.explanation: The aged locker demonstrates realistic paint flaking and rust accumulation, particularly around the vents and edges.

grey-green_painted_steel.observations: The base color is a consistent grey-green across all as-built views, matching the warship steel brief.

bare_hardware.observations: Hardware elements like the locker handle and chair joints appear as distinct, unpainted metal in the as-built state.

dark_trim.observations: Subtle dark trim is visible on the chair legs and locker base in the as-built state.

edge_corrosion.observations: The aged state shows significant rust and paint loss concentrated on the vertical edges and corners of both objects.

rust_runs.observations: Narrow, downward-streaking rust marks are clearly visible on the vertical faces of the aged locker and chair.

settled_dust.observations: A fine, soft layer of dust is visible on the upward-facing surfaces of the chair seat and locker top in the aged state.

faded_fabric.observations: The chair's fabric pad appears as a muted, woven texture that looks appropriately aged and faded.

findings: The aged fabric pad on the chair could benefit from slightly more texture variation to better match the severity of the surrounding metal corrosion.
The rust runs on the locker are very effective, but the transition from paint to bare metal could be slightly softer in some areas to avoid a hard-edged look.
limitations: The orthographic views make it difficult to fully assess the 3D relief of the corrosion, though the 2D textures appear well-integrated.

acceptance.rule: candidate aged >= locker aged in this review, numeric gates pass, all four view blocks inspected
